english.note: Use 自由 as the all-purpose noun for being free or lacking constraints.
This is the all-purpose noun for liberty, including general freedom and freedom from imprisonment or government control.
Use this for the resulting state of being free rather than the act of freeing someone.

examples.english: During my days off, I have the freedom to arrange my own time.
examples.traditional: 放假嗰幾日，我可以自由安排時間。
examples.jyutping: fong3 gaa3 go2 gei2 jat6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 on1 paai4 si4 gaan3

examples.english: We have liberty to speak our minds, so we don’t have to worry about saying the wrong thing.
examples.traditional: 我哋有言論自由，唔使驚講錯嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jau5 jin4 leon6 zi6 jau4 m4 sai2 geng1 gong2 co3 je5

examples.english: Not having to answer to anyone anymore really feels like liberation.
examples.traditional: 而家唔使再睇人面色，真係有自由。
examples.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 m4 sai2 zoi3 tai2 jan4 min6 sik1 zan1 hai6 jau5 zi6 jau4
